description: Plan the GPA needed on upcoming credits to reach a target cumulative GPA. Inputs: current_gpa (0 to 7), credits_completed (0 or more), target_gpa (0 to 7), upcoming_credits (greater than 0) and a scale id, which sets the top grade point the scale allows. Says so when the target is already reached or would take more than one term. Example prompt: "I have a 3.1 GPA over 60 credits. What GPA do I need next semester to reach 3.4?"

current_gpa.description: Your cumulative GPA so far, between 0 and 7.

scale.description: Grade scale id: "us4", "us4plus", "ontario-college", "uk-classification", "australia-hd" or "weighted-5.0". Defaults to "us4". Ask the student which one their school uses if unsure.

target_gpa.description: The cumulative GPA you want to reach, between 0 and 7.

upcoming_credits.description: Credits you will take next, greater than 0.

name: target_gpa_planner

already_there.description: True when the target is already reached, so a 0.0 on the upcoming credits keeps it.

max_points.description: The top grade point the scale allows.

needed_gpa.description: The GPA needed on the upcoming credits. It is below 0 when the target is already reached, and above the top of the scale when the target takes more than one term.

possible.description: True when the target can be reached in one term on this scale.

scale.description: The scale id the plan was made on.

scale_name.description: The name of the scale the plan was made on.

upcoming_credits.description: The credits you will take next.

title: Target GPA planner
